_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-5.5)**_

No, it wasn't correct. `import('remark-gfm')` returns a Promise (a module namespace), not the plugin function, so remark would receive an invalid plugin.

I changed `.storybook/main.ts` to the form from the Storybook docs:

```ts
import remarkGfm from 'remark-gfm';
// ...
remarkPlugins: [remarkGfm],
```

The rest of the `@storybook/addon-docs` options block was already right. I haven't restarted Storybook to check it. You can also delete the commented-out `// "@storybook/addon-docs"` line.
